title: Choose Market Mate's visual world
question: Choose the world that should govern the full supervisory dashboard and every deeper surface.

options.label: Authority Topography
options.lineage: survey maps, plotting tables, and transparent operational overlays
options.thesis: The whole system becomes one navigable terrain whose contours reveal trust, attention, performance, and capital at once.
options.viewport: A full-screen operational map centers the Trust Zone, with four surrounding territories—Attention, Performance, Capital, and Evidence—and one red cost-over-cap contour immediately visible.
options.risk: The map must remain an exact information model; decorative geography would obscure rather than clarify authority.

raised.raise: History remains a continuous inspectable trail beneath every current-state mark.
The terrain is derived only from auditable system state, never decorative randomness.
Urgency changes scale and prominence before it changes color.
Opening a territory preserves the surrounding heads-up context.

options.label: Interlocking Board
options.lineage: railway signal boxes and route-interlocking diagrams
options.thesis: Market Mate reads as a governed route network where no state can appear open unless every upstream gate aligns.
options.viewport: One schematic routes Incubator evidence through Sentinel gates toward Engine state, while performance, cash, costs, approvals, and emergencies branch as inspectable signal stations.
options.risk: Its infrastructural precision can feel cold, and its familiarity makes it the direction most safety-critical dashboards naturally converge on.

options.label: Evidence Spectrum
options.lineage: calibrated spectrograms and atomic emission-line plates
options.thesis: Every domain registers on one calibrated rail, with freshness, trust, and urgency expressed through line form before color.
options.viewport: A single off-center rail spans the first view; doubled and full-height marks expose what needs attention while a selected domain blooms into a large evidence plate without leaving the rail.
options.case: It beats the map on scan discipline and dense-state elegance, but identifies less strongly with Market Mate's explicit governance topology.
options.risk: Its restraint can become cryptic unless every line form has a persistent plain-language legend.

options.label: Phosphor Transcript
options.lineage: green-phosphor terminals in midnight machine rooms
options.thesis: The system explains itself as a continuous, keyboard-first operational transcript.
options.viewport: Current truth prints above a searchable transcript of every consequential state transition.
options.case: It identifies with technical operations but cannot provide the requested everything-at-once overview without becoming a conventional terminal dashboard.
options.kept: Continuous history is treated as part of the current state, not a separate archive.
options.risk: It repeats the incumbent aesthetic and the trading-terminal category rut.

options.label: Living State Mark
options.thesis: One deterministic mark changes with trust, authority, performance, and cost, then tunes every surface around it.
options.viewport: A state-derived mark occupies the center while its four parameters unfold into the dashboard's major domains.
options.case: It is memorable but makes visual identity carry too much audit meaning and risks confusing change with authority.
options.kept: Every visual variation must derive from an explainable, deterministic state.
options.risk: A changing identity can undermine the stable recognition required during emergencies.

options.label: Evidence Archive Wall
options.lineage: indexed specimen drawers and stacked archive boxes
options.thesis: Each system domain is an indexed evidence container that opens without losing the whole collection.
options.viewport: A wall of labeled domains exposes state on each spine; the selected one slides forward and opens into evidence.
options.case: It supports drill-down beautifully but frames a live safety system as stored material rather than an active governed process.
options.kept: Depth opens in place so the Principal never loses the surrounding overview.
options.risk: The collection metaphor makes urgent state feel too passive.

options.label: State Weather
options.lineage: semantic weather maps and typographic storm systems
options.thesis: System language gathers into visible fronts, warnings, and clear zones across one field.
options.viewport: Trust, performance, cost, and risk form readable fronts whose movement reveals the changing system.
options.case: It dramatizes change but sacrifices the stable coordinates and exact provenance required for audit.
options.kept: Motion should express a state transition's cause and direction, not decorate a refresh.
options.risk: Metaphorical movement can imply uncertainty that the evidence does not support.

options.label: Priority Caption Field
options.thesis: Operational events announce themselves in a field where typographic scale equals urgency.
options.viewport: The dominant issue lands large while quieter system truths remain pinned around it.
options.case: It makes attention unmistakable but cannot carry the calm, persistent overview needed when nothing is wrong.
options.kept: Urgency must change hierarchy and scale before relying on color.
options.risk: Emotional visual language is too volatile for routine supervision.

canonCard.label: Institutional Risk Dashboard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional sidebar, metric strip, alert queue, charts, and drill-down tables executed with exceptional restraint.
canonCard.viewport: A persistent sidebar frames a top status strip, attention queue, after-cost performance chart, cash position, operating costs, and evidence freshness.
canonCard.risk: It is immediately usable but deliberately indistinguishable from mature financial and observability software.
